title: 义务教育教科书·英语（清华）二年级上册

sentences.cn: 我有一个包和一个盒子。
sentences.en: I have a bag and a box.
I drink juice and eat noodles.
The kite is in the sky.

sentences.cn: 我的外套是旧的，可我的衬衫是新的。
sentences.en: My coat is old, but my shirt is new.
I wear shorts and a T-shirt today.
It is cloudy and rainy today.
I like snow and the snowman.
We stay at home and make a kite.
We go swimming in the river.
The swing is in the park.
The box is heavy, but the kite is light.
The tail is long, and the ruler is short.
The cat is thin and small.
A wolf is in the forest.
